timing.median_ms: guest Git status, Go build and uncached Go test subprocess durations
timing.work_with_transfer_ns: guest work plus the host Docker CLI time to deliver the edit or reset
timing.host_wall_ns: elapsed host time for any copy plus the Docker exec and guest validation
timing.initial_transfer_ns: one host Docker CLI copy of the bundle and driver files to each container
timing.clone_ns: guest Git bundle clone and checkout

timing.scored_ns: per job, sum of Git status, Go build and uncached Go test subprocess durations
timing.all_jobs_overlap_ns: time with all workers simultaneously in a measured subprocess

timing.incremental_state: first batch after an atomic host-only main.go edit with a unique revision per pair
